agentic-engineering-kit.description: Kit for building software with AI agents from brief to client hand-over: 22 skills, 12 subagents, an architecture-advisor MCP server (C#) that compares 10 designs against real-world systems, a privacy guard, security reviews and demo recorders. Built around the Baton model.

agentic-building-blocks.description: Nine dependency-free .NET 8 packages for what every project rebuilds: login (PBKDF2), bearer tokens, subscriptions, notifications, idempotency keys, transactional outbox and audit trail. 239 tests, a sample API and a design dossier.

casino-platform.description: B2B casino platform for operators and game studios on PostgreSQL: wallet, responsible gambling, game launch, bonuses, reporting. Includes Kiln, a PixiJS slot framework with two playable games, and Catwalk, where players replay every round they played.

framely.description: Photo-first social app for a photographers' network (fictional client), Instagram-style: posts with alt text, an ad-free fan-out-on-write home feed, and location data stripped from every photo. Modular monolith, .NET 8 + React.

plaza.description: Neighbourhood community network, Facebook-groups style: verified residents post notices and safety alerts, live SignalR notifications, moderation with an audit trail. Modular monolith, ASP.NET Core + React.

relay.description: Private messaging for low-end phones on zero-rated data, WhatsApp-style: sent, delivered and read ticks, offline delivery, and no message bodies kept on the server after delivery. ASP.NET Core SignalR modular monolith + React.

cinewave.description: Subscription film streaming for an African film library, Netflix-style: licensing per country, HLS video from a CDN, continue watching across devices, idempotent progress saves. Modular monolith, .NET 8 + React.

wavelength.description: Music streaming for independent labels, Spotify-style: accent-insensitive search, every play counted once via idempotent play events, and an append-only royalty ledger that reconciles to the cent. .NET 8 + React.

huddle.description: Digital banking for stokvel savings groups: group balances, contributions and statements on a double-entry, append-only ledger with no editable balances. .NET 8 modular monolith + React.

clio.description: AI extraction of loan terms from scanned term sheets: every field with a confidence score and its source highlighted, and an analyst review queue before anything is approved. Clean Architecture, .NET 8 + React, with an evaluation suite.

metis.description: Ranks inbound loan applications by explainable lending criteria and shows the top reasons behind every rank, so strong deals stop waiting behind weak ones. Vertical-slice modular monolith, .NET 8 + Angular.

hestia.description: Investor document portal for a property lender: statements in one place instead of email attachments, tenant isolation, and an access log showing who opened which document and when. ASP.NET Core modular monolith + Blazor.

chronos.description: Event-sourced ledger for property loans: drawdowns, interest and repayments with four-eyes approval, and any loan replayed as of a past date. CQRS inside a .NET 8 modular monolith + React.

demeter.description: Data pipeline for borrowers' rent rolls in many layouts: raw, clean and serve stages, each file reconciled to its stated total or quarantined, and every dashboard figure traced to its source line. Python, FastAPI, pydantic.

janus.description: Strangler-fig migration off a legacy terminal app: a facade routes each capability to legacy, shadow (run both and compare) or new, and falls back when the old system is down. .NET 8 + a React traffic console.

Legion91919.description: Profile: Ettienne, senior engineer who designs systems on purpose and builds them with AI agents, with a recorded architecture decision for every project.

legion91919.github.io.description: Portfolio site: thirteen systems with live demos, the architecture each one got and why, and a decision matrix scoring 10 designs per project.
